findings.F1: Sense 1 definition says uncountable noun / not much instead of plural countable noun / not many.
findings.F2: Sense 2 example 'Could I borrow a few money?' is ungrammatical and models a learner error.
findings.F3: Usage note gives less/least as the comparative and superlative of few, and presents 'less people' and 'the least mistakes' as correct.
findings.F4: The few / a few contrast is restated in the core idea, both explanations, the usage note, and the adaptation note.
findings.F5: Inflections omit the real forms fewer and fewest.
findings.F6: The idiom 'few and far between' is missing from phrases.
findings.F7: Uses of few after another determiner (every few days) are not covered.
findings.F8: 'quite a few' (a fairly large number) is listed as a collocation of the small-number sense instead of being its own phrase.
